geometry.rights: US Census public data; attribution displayed

market_locations.precision: place representative point, never a lead address

unknown_market: Retained in the board and map member list with No location; never guessed, geocoded or placed at 0,0. Missing, malformed and ambiguous market points are unlocated.
membership: Exact canonical lead IDs and counts from the current search, owner, stage and market filters; marker members plus no-location members equal the board.
selection: One selected lead ID highlights its board card, map member and containing market marker; retain it through matching filters and clear it when excluded.
precision: Market area only. Census place points never claim lead-address coordinates.
phone_stage: All stages shows all filtered lanes; both stage selectors apply the same filter.
